title: Remote state test hides the reason it returned false
root_cause: The assertion reports only that healthy is false, and the endpoint is masked. The request could have failed to reach the key-value service, or it could have succeeded with a response that the test incorrectly rejects; the output does not distinguish them.

relevant_evidence.why: The test reports an assertion failure without request or response details.
The endpoint is masked in the step environment.
A failed request and a nonmatching body both produce false.
